q: When the earth shall quake most violently
v.s: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
v.c: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking,

q: ...when the earth will throw up loads of
v.s: And the earth discharges its burdens
v.c: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents,

q: ...and man will ask, “What is the matter with her
v.s: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
v.c: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—

q: (by giving evidence against people because she would have seen everything that had been done on her)...
v.s: That Day, it will report its news
v.c: on that Day the earth will recount everything,

v.s: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.
v.c: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺.

q: On that day people will return
(They will therefore proceed either to Jannah or to Jahannam, depending on the group they are with.)
v.s: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
v.c: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds.

q: done an atom's weight of good will see it
(the consequences when he is rewarded for it)...
v.s: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
v.c: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.

q: ...and whoever has done an atom's weight of evil
(the consequences when he is punished for it).
v.s: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
v.c: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
